name: Sink gasket 30 / 51
description: Ring, 30 mm inner and 51 mm outer diameter. Flat underside; the top tapers from 3 mm thick at the inner edge to 0.6 mm at the outer edge. A 35 mm diameter recess in the flat side, 0.65 mm deep, thins the ring around the hole to about 1.8 to 2.35 mm. Print in TPU, flat side down.
